description: This is a Java source file for a Spring MVC controller named CustomerController, managing customer-related operations in an e-commerce admin panel, including viewing, editing, saving customer details, listing customers, paginating, and resetting passwords.

classes.name: CustomerController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for managing customer data in admin interface, including CRUD operations, listing, paginating, and resetting passwords.

methods.name: displayCustomer
methods.description: Handles GET request to display customer details page; loads customer data if ID provided for editing.

methods.name: saveCustomer
methods.description: Handles POST request to save or update customer details with validation.

methods.name: saveCustomerAttributes
methods.description: Handles POST request to save customer attribute selections via AJAX.

methods.name: displayCustomers
methods.description: Handles GET request to show the customer list page.

methods.name: pageCustomers
methods.description: Handles POST request to return JSON with paginated customer data.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Handles POST request to reset a customer's password, generate a new random password, update it, and send notification email.
